#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    string line;
    getline(cin, line);
    vector<char> inputChars(line.begin(), line.end());
    int length = line.length();

    vector<string> targets = {"00", "25", "50", "75"};
    int totalCount = 0;

    if (inputChars.size() == 1) {
        if (inputChars[0] == '0' || inputChars[0] == 'X' || inputChars[0] == '_') totalCount++;
    } else {
        for (const string& target : targets) {
            int fixedX = -1;
            int index = 0;
            bool valid = true;
            for (int i = length - 2; i < length; i++) {
                char current = inputChars[i];
                char expected = target[index++];
                if (current == '_') continue;
                else if (current == 'X') {
                    if (fixedX == -1) fixedX = expected - '0';
                    else if (fixedX != expected - '0') {
                        valid = false;
                        break;
                    }
                } else if (current != expected) {
                    valid = false;
                    break;
                }
            }
            if (!valid) continue;
            if (length == 2) {
                if (target[0] == '0') continue;
                totalCount++;
                continue;
            }
            vector<char> tempInput = inputChars;
            int countX = 0;
            for (char c : inputChars) if (c == 'X') countX++;
            if (fixedX != -1 || countX == 0) {
                if (fixedX != -1) {
                    for (int k = 0; k < length; k++) {
                        if (inputChars[k] == 'X') tempInput[k] = (char)(fixedX + '0');
                    }
                }
                if (tempInput[0] == '0') continue;
                long long ways = 1;
                for (int k = 0; k < length - 2; k++) {
                    if (tempInput[k] == '_') {
                        ways *= (k == 0) ? 9 : 10;
                    }
                }
                totalCount += ways;
            } else {
                if (tempInput[0] == '0') continue;
                long long ways = 1;
                for (int k = 0; k < length - 2; k++) {
                    if (tempInput[k] == '_') {
                        ways *= (k == 0) ? 9 : 10;
                    }
                }
                if (tempInput[0] == 'X') {
                    ways *= 9;
                } else {
                    ways *= 10;
                }
                totalCount += ways;
            }
        }
    }
    cout << totalCount << "\n";
    return 0;
}
